reason: An app with our own name would fix the desk complaints, and € 449 a month is small money for a club our size. But two founders with no club live yet, plus a migration of 950 members, is not something I take to the board in a normal month.
objection: No club is actually running on it. If the import or the iDEAL payments go wrong I have 950 members at my desk, and GOLF.NL already books tee times for free. I also see nothing here that brings in more green fee, buggy or bar revenue.
would_change_my_mind: Golfclub Zwolle running live for a full season, with a manager I can call, and figures showing more guest bookings or extra spend through the app.
